source: William R. Shepherd, Historical Atlas, New York: Henry Holt, 1926, map 'Europe and the Mediterranean Lands about 1190'. Scan of the Perry-Castañeda Library Map Collection, University of Texas Libraries, which states the scanned maps as public domain unless marked otherwise; this one is not marked. Image read from the identical scan on Wikimedia Commons, File:Europe_mediterranean_1190.jpg, 2293 x 1810 px.
method: Rough hand trace of the outer border of the area coloured as the Holy Roman Empire, read on a 20 px grid from the full-size scan, clockwise from the North Sea coast. Corsica and Sardinia, coloured alike, are left out. Control points are town dots read on zoomed crops; their modern coordinates georeference the trace with a quadratic fit. Traced on 2026-11-12 by the implementing agent; an interpretation of this project, not a historical boundary.
